headline: Source: Texans' Nico Collins (hamstring) uncertain for Week 2
summary: Texans star wide receiver Nico Collins suffered a hamstring injury during Wednesday's practice and is uncertain to play in Week 2 against the Bengals, a source told ESPN.

headline: Lions Down Multiple O-Line Starters
summary: Visiting Buffalo on Thursday night, Detroit will have to start multiple backups along the offensive line. The Lions have ruled out right tackle Blake Miller (knee) and left guard Christian Mahogany (hip) for Week 2. Beginning with the March release of longtime stalwart Taylor Decker, the Lions shook up their offensive tackle alignment in the offseason. […]

headline: Tua Tagovailoa remains out of practice on Thursday
summary: At this point, it looks like Tua Tagovailoa is out of the running to start Atlanta's Week 2 matchup against Carolina.

headline: Brian Belichick takes over Steve Belichick's role calling defense for Bill Belichick's team
summary: With one of Bill Belichick's sons resigning as his defensive coordinator, Belichick's other son will take on the role.

headline: Packers on a 6-game skid going back to last season and face a Jets squad looking for a 2-0 start
summary: — It has been quite a while since Jordan Love and the Green Bay Packers walked off the field with a victory.

headline: The 49ers return from dominating win in Australia to take on the Dolphins in home opener
summary: — The scenario to start the season for the San Francisco 49ers couldn't have been much more challenging.
